verdict.rationale: The official vuejs/core repository README sends users to an official community chat at chat.vuejs.org for questions and support, alongside the official forum. That directly covers joining an official chatroom to get help and connect with other users. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the chat (platform, channels, how to join), and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the chat for help (community posts mention only the forum, guide and GitHub issues).
